name: Klaviyo
description: Klaviyo is a marketing automation and customer data platform for email, SMS, mobile messaging, audiences, campaigns, flows, and commerce-connected customer journeys.
agentUseSummary: Connect one Klaviyo Account through Relay-owned confidential OAuth with mandatory PKCE and only accounts:read, lists:read, and campaigns:read. Relay rotates the expiring provider token pair and exposes only exact Account metadata, ten recently updated sparse List summaries, and twenty-five recent email Campaign lifecycle summaries at a pinned API revision; profiles, behavior, content, audiences, raw queries, pagination, exports, broader APIs, and writes remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same three read-only tools run while exact-account and scope binding, the pinned revision, sparse fields, page limits, audit, redaction, token rotation, and provider limits remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts three bounded Klaviyo metadata wrappers and attaches the encrypted, account-bound rotating OAuth token server-side.
Railway mounts three bounded Klaviyo metadata wrappers and attaches the encrypted, account-bound rotating OAuth token server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: Klaviyo requires Relay to create a confidential OAuth app with the exact Railway callback, least scopes, and secure client credentials. Railway staging credentials and an authorized acceptance Account are not configured in this code-only task.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task, create Relay's Klaviyo OAuth app with https://api.relayconsole.work/api/v1/marketplace/oauth/klaviyo/callback and only accounts:read lists:read campaigns:read, configure Railway staging client credentials, then verify PKCE, exact Account binding, all three sparse reads at revision 2026-04-15, serialized refresh and complete-pair replacement, 10-per-minute refresh limiting, revoke/uninstall, 90-day inactivity behavior, app warnings or review requirements, endpoint rate limits, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Klaviyo documents confidential authorization-code OAuth with mandatory PKCE S256, Basic-auth form token and refresh requests at a.klaviyo.com, account-bound one-hour access tokens, refresh tokens revoked after 90 idle days, a 10-refresh-per-minute ceiling, and Basic-auth revocation.
GET /api/accounts requires accounts:read, returns exactly one Account, supports sparse account fields, and publishes XS limits of 1 request per second and 15 per minute.
GET /api/lists requires lists:read and supports a maximum page size of 10, updated sorting, and sparse name/created/updated/opt-in fields without profiles or profile counts.
GET /api/campaigns requires campaigns:read and, at the pinned 2026-04-15 revision, requires a channel filter while supporting bounded page size, updated sorting, and sparse lifecycle fields.
